request.prompt:
Goods: Analogue quartz wristwatch, stainless steel case
Country of origin: CH

Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:
- 91: Clocks and watches and parts thereof
    contains 911220: Clock cases and similar cases for other goods of chapter 91; other than watch cases
    contains 911290: Clock cases and similar cases for other goods of chapter 91; other than watch cases, parts thereof
    contains 910121: Wrist-watches; (not electrically operated), automatic winding, whether or not incorporating a stop-watch facility, case of precious metal or of metal clad with precious metal
    contains 910129: Wrist-watches; (not electrically operated), (not automatic winding), whether or not incorporating a stop-watch facility, case of precious metal or of metal clad with precious metal
    contains 910199: Pocket-watches and other watches, including stop-watches; (excluding wrist-watches), with case of precious metal or of metal clad with precious metal, not electrically operated
    contains 910111: Wrist-watches; electrically operated, with or without a stop-watch, with case of precious metal or of metal clad with precious metal, with mechanical display only
    contains 910119: Wrist-watches; electrically operated, with or without a stop-watch, with case of precious metal or metal clad with precious metal, without mechanical display
    contains 910191: Pocket-watches and other watches, including stop-watches; (excluding wrist-watches), with case of precious metal or of metal clad with precious metal, electrically operated
    contains 910229: Wrist-watches; whether or not incorporating a stop-watch facility, with other than automatic winding
    contains 911120: Watch cases; of base metal, whether or not gold-plated or silver-plated
    contains 910221: Wrist-watches; whether or not incorporating a stop-watch facility, with automatic winding
- 42: Articles of leather; saddlery and harness; travel goods, handbags and similar containers; articles of animal gut (other than silk-worm gut)
    contains 420211: Cases and containers; trunks, suit-cases, vanity-cases, executive-cases, brief-cases, school satchels and similar containers, with outer surface of leather or of composition leather
    contains 420212: Cases and containers; trunks, suit-cases, vanity-cases, executive-cases, brief-cases, school satchels and similar containers, with outer surface of plastics or of textile materials
    contains 420219: Cases and containers; trunks, suit-cases, vanity-cases, executive-cases, brief-cases, school satchels and similar containers, of vulcanised fibre or of paperboard, or wholly or mainly covered with such materials or with paper
- 73: Iron or steel articles
    contains 730429: Iron or steel (excluding cast iron or stainless steel); seamless, casing and tubing, of a kind used in drilling for oil or gas
    contains 730629: Iron or steel (excluding cast iron); casing and tubing of a kind used in drilling for oil and gas (other than stainless steel or seamless), n.e.c. in chapter 73
    contains 730721: Steel, stainless; tube or pipe fittings, flanges, of stainless steel
    contains 731412: Iron or steel; woven cloth, endless bands for machinery, of stainless steel
    contains 731414: Iron or steel; woven cloth, of stainless steel, (other than endless bands for machinery)
    contains 731419: Iron or steel; woven cloth, other than of stainless steel

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A quartz wristwatch is a wrist-watch classified in Chapter 91 (Clocks and watches); the stainless steel case does not move it to Chapter 73.
